title: About
tagline: Beat-synced reels, right in your browser.

what.title: What the app does
what.body: Beatapp turns your photos and videos into an edit synced to the beat of your music. You import your media and an audio track, the app analyses the tempo, then spreads your shots across the beats. You then adjust durations, framing, text and effects before exporting an MP4 file ready to publish.

privacy.title: Your files stay with you
privacy.body: Everything happens in your browser. No account is required, no file is sent to a server, and no usage data is collected. Your photos, videos and music never leave your device: they are stored locally, and both analysis and export run on your machine.
privacy.offline: Once loaded, the app works without a connection.

features.title: Main features
features.beat: Automatic tempo detection and shots snapped to the beat
features.import: Import photos, videos, an existing reel, audio files or a direct link
features.edit: Trimming, framing, rotation, slow zoom and colour filters
features.transitions: Transitions between shots, with direction and an added effect
features.text: Text, synced lyrics, masks cut out of the letters
features.export: MP4 export up to 4K, with a choice of format and quality

limits.title: What the app cannot do
limits.social: Instagram, TikTok and YouTube links cannot be downloaded: those platforms forbid it from a browser. Save the video to your device first, then import the file.
limits.transcription: Lyrics are not transcribed automatically. No speech recognition engine runs in a browser without sending your audio elsewhere, which would break the privacy promise. You paste your lyrics and the app aligns them to the detected beat.
